# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2000

**Ordinance authorizing the Municipal Mayor to utilize appropriation for Human Resource Management.**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the Municipal Mayor, [[Domingo L. Tan]], to utilize the appropriation in the Office of the Human Resource Management Officer V to the newly created position, Municipal Government Department Head I in the Office of the Human Resource Management. The appropriation in the Office of the Human Resource Management Officer V is realigned to the Municipal Government Department Head I in the Human Resource Management Office. This ordinance takes effect immediately.

## Key Provisions

1.  Section 1. The appropriation in the Office of the Human Resource Management Officer V is hereby realigned to the Municipal Government Department Head I in the Human Resource Management Office.
2.  Section 2. This Ordinance shall authorize the Municipal Mayor, Hon. [[Domingo L. Tan]] to utilize the appropriation in the Office of the Human Resource Management Officer V to the newly created position, Municipal Government Department Head I in the Office of the Human Resource Management, [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
3.  Section 3. This ordinance shall take effect immediately.
